page_title: LUT 1-1 LIV | Luton v Liverpool 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.

90+5' 1 - 1 Harvey Elliott sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Luis Diaz (Liverpool) rises above the defenders to meet the ball and heads it straight into the right side of the goal. The score sheet now reads 1:1.
90+3' The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Issa Kabore (Luton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
89' 4:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
88' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

86' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
85' The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
83' Here comes a substitution. Ryan Gravenberch is given a rest as he is replaced by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).

80' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Tahith Chong (Luton) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Issa Kabore. The score is now 1:0.
80' Here is a change. Chiedozie Ogbene is going off and Rob Edwards gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Brown (Luton).
76' A corner kick by Luton is thwarted by the well prepared Alisson (Liverpool).
75' Jurgen Klopp is stunned as referee Andy Madley shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
75' Carlton Morris will be replaced by Elijah Adebayo (Luton).
74' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
74' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will deliver the corner kick.

73' Thomas Kaminski pulls off a great save to deny Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

71' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
67' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) replacing Joe Gomez.
66' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Diogo Jota.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dominik Szoboszlai walks off the pitch to be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
66' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

65' Carlton Morris (Luton) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Alisson is alert and denies him. The referee points to the corner flag and Luton will take a corner.
64' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andy Madley signals.

63' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
61' Substitution. Andros Townsend makes way for Tahith Chong (Luton).
60' Looks like Issa Kabore (Luton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
59' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
57' The ball possession at the moment is 27:73.
55' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will miss the next game.
54' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' Liverpool take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' Andros Townsend (Luton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
50' Liverpool are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Andy Madley blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Yellow card. Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

41' The ball rebounds out to Ross Barkley (Luton) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
39' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).
38' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:3.
36' Luton force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Issa Kabore (Luton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
34' Liverpool work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

33' Great save! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Thomas Kaminski. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
31' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
28' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) anticipates the cross from Mohamed Salah, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.

21' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
20' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Luton.

15' Issa Kabore (Luton) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
15' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

13' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the crossbar. He did everything right but score! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
12' 39:61 – the ratio of ball possession.
11' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Alfie Doughty (Luton) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
5' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.
5' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
3' A cross from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
3' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Andy Madley will officiate today.
